title: EOS classifier fix — explicit read-only audit misclassified as PATCH_PRODUCER
intent:
Fix the narrow EOS intake-classification defect exposed by Issue #872: an explicitly read-only analysis mission that says `READ_ONLY_ANALYSIS`, `Do not fix anything`, and prohibits edits/patches/PRs was classified as `PATCH_PRODUCER` because implementation/fix-related words appeared in descriptive or negative context.

Required work:
1. Reproduce the current-main #872 classification from `docs/orchestration/work-intake/EOS-ISSUE-872.work.json`: requested mission is read-only analysis, but `execution.taskClass` is `PATCH_PRODUCER`, `expectedArtifactClass` is `PATCH`, and `requiredExecutionReceipts` includes `tests` while `authority.authorizedExecutionProfile` correctly remains `READ_ONLY_ANALYSIS`.
2. Identify the classifier rule that treats implementation/fix/build/code-change keywords in prohibitions, examples, remediation descriptions, or other non-requested-change context as positive mutation intent.
3. Make explicit read-only intent and explicit mutation prohibitions classify as `READ_ONLY_ANALYSIS` unless the requested work actually asks the worker to edit/build/implement/fix source. Keep ambiguous cases fail-closed to the safe read-only class; never infer `GOVERNED_INTEGRATION`.
4. Add focused regression tests using #872-like text proving: explicit `READ_ONLY_ANALYSIS` + `Do not fix anything` + remediation/fix vocabulary remains read-only; genuine implementation requests remain `PATCH_PRODUCER`; `READ_ONLY_VERIFY` remains non-mutating; issue/worker text cannot self-authorize a stronger execution profile.
5. Run focused classifier tests and the normal orchestration regression suite.
6. Produce a governed patch/PR with verifier evidence. Do not treat analysis-only output as completion.
7. After the fix is merged, redispatch #872 under its original read-only 10-child mission without widening or changing its completion criteria.

Completion:
Complete only when the classifier regression is fixed on current main with passing regression evidence, the governed patch is merged through the normal review path, and a fresh #872 dispatch artifact correctly records `execution.taskClass: READ_ONLY_ANALYSIS` with `authority.authorizedExecutionProfile: READ_ONLY_ANALYSIS`. No auto-merge or deploy.
scope: Smallest EOS intake classifier correction and focused regression coverage only. Preserve the existing two-key model: request `taskClass` is separate from `authority.authorizedExecutionProfile`. Do not widen authority, provider boundaries, shell permissions, merge/deploy rights, credential access, or protected-branch permissions. Do not redesign unrelated EOS tooling.

source.provenance: Authenticated GitHub owner issue labeled eos-intake

authority.basis: EOS accepted the validated, Owner-submitted, explicitly scoped Issue under the issue-intake policy.
